intro: First Timothy is Paul's advice to his young friend Timothy, leading the church in Ephesus.
Chapters one to three cover sound teaching, prayer, and choosing good leaders. Chapters four to six give personal advice: be an example, care for widows, and beware the love of money.
Paul wrote it late in his life.
Listen for: fight the good fight of faith.

card.parts: Ch. 1–3: teaching, prayer, leaders | Ch. 4–6: personal advice
card.key: Christ came to save sinners (1) · Be an example (4) · The love of money (6)
